purpose: Proves a source-supplied days_left field cannot be treated as an observed booking date.

audited_reality: Business class collapses to ONE implied collection date (2022-02-10, 93487/93487 rows). Economy is 2022-02-09/10. days_left is arithmetic, not observed.

rows.trap: Looks like a same-day observation. It is not. It is one crawl on 2022-02-10.

assertion: GROUP BY implied_search_date over the full file yields <= 2 dates. Therefore ANY index computed from this file measures travel-date variation, never price movement over collection time.
required_adapter_behaviour: REJECT with reason DERIVED_HORIZON_NO_OBSERVED_SEARCH_TIMESTAMP. Do not populate search_timestamp.
